title: Create routing and bypass tests
description:
Create tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp using the built-in juce::UnitTest framework and register it in CMakeLists.txt on the existing console test-runner target. This is a serialized CMakeLists.txt write: it runs after f.6 and before f.8.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h (topologies, normalization, mixing, bypass surface)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (how the processor is constructed and prepared in existing tests)
- An existing test file under tests/ (for the juce::UnitTest registration idiom already used in this repo)
- CMakeLists.txt (the console test-runner target and its target_sources list)

Required test coverage:
- All three topologies: Parallel, A-into-B, and B-into-A produce the expected voice contributions, including the cascade gains cos(pi*cascade/2) and sin(pi*cascade/2).
- Wet voice normalization N = sqrt(max(1, l_A*l_A + l_B*l_B)) holds for representative level pairs, including l_A = l_B = 1 and l_A = l_B = 0.5.
- A routing topology change is click-free: assert the sample-to-sample delta of the output stays below a stated small threshold across the 30 ms transition, and that the transition length corresponds to 30 ms at the test sample rate.
- Hard bypass: wet fades out, dry is preserved sample-accurately, and the tail is cleared only after the transition completes.
- Trails bypass: no new delay input enters the loop (feed a burst then engage trails and assert the tail contains no contribution from post-engage input), while dry continues unchanged.
- Bypass transitions measure 20 ms and are click-free by the same delta threshold.
- Insert mixing satisfies dryGain = cos(pi*m/2) and wetGain = sin(pi*m/2) within a stated tolerance; Send mixing outputs wet only.

Use only juce::UnitTest. Catch2, GoogleTest, and every other third-party framework are forbidden, and no new dependency may be introduced. Tests must be deterministic: fixed sample rates (use 48000 Hz and 44100 Hz), fixed block sizes, and no reliance on wall-clock timing.

In CMakeLists.txt, add only tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp to the existing test-runner target sources. Do not add or reorder other test files and do not modify the plugin target's source list.
acceptance_criteria: tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp exists and defines juce::UnitTest subclasses with static instances, using no third-party test framework
tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp asserts Parallel, A-into-B, and B-into-A topology behavior including the cos(pi*cascade/2) and sin(pi*cascade/2) cascade gains
tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp asserts wet normalization N = sqrt(max(1, l_A*l_A + l_B*l_B)) for at least two level pairs
tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp asserts the routing transition spans 30 ms and is click-free against an explicit sample-delta threshold
tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp asserts hard bypass preserves dry and clears the tail only after the transition, and that trails bypass admits no post-engage delay input while dry continues
tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp asserts Insert gains dryGain = cos(pi*m/2) and wetGain = sin(pi*m/2) within a stated tolerance and that Send outputs wet only
